props.name: actions
props.comment: Header actions (show/delete buttons); nothing by default.

props.name: id
props.comment: Override the record id (defaults to the `:id` route param).

props.name: resource
props.comment: Override the ambient resource (defaults to the `<Resource>` context).

props.name: title
props.comment: Header title. A string/element renders as an `<h2>`; `false` omits it.
